details:
I've been having an issue in VRChat for a while where, while I'm playing with friends or other people, their microphones will randomly cut out even though they don't appear to be lagging. The same thing happens to me sometimes, where my microphone cuts out or other players hear me cutting in and out.

I've also noticed that players will randomly appear to lag or freeze even when they aren't actually experiencing lag on their end. This makes it difficult to have conversations and play normally.

I've already tried clearing my VRChat cache to see if that would fix the issue, but it didn't help.

Steps I've tried:

Clearing my cache

Restarting my game

Rejoining instances

Behavior:

Players' microphones randomly cut out, including mine, and players sometimes appear to lag or freeze despite not actually lagging.

This has been happening consistently for a while, and I'd appreciate any help figuring out what could be causing it.
title: Voice Chat Cutting Out and Random Player Lag When Actually Not Lagging
